column1: # CEOS-APPROX SWEEP, REGION GEOMETRY (2026-09-24): an older hexapole-corrected column -- CEOS CESCOR-like, tuned at
# 30 mrad -- opened to 80 mrad with the probe known. Can a widespread instrument still give depth-resolved ptychography
# by tanking its aberrations? Tableau: campaign/aberration_waves.py ceos_tableau -- A5 = 1.0 mm (CEOS, the limiting
# residual); parasitic A4 = B4 = 10 um (central: A5 must stay the limiting term, which caps them near 27 um); tuned
# terms 0.1 waves at the aperture they are tuned at. C5 = 1 mm fixed, as in the round sweep. aber_json is generated.
#   round_a<A>    controls: the round sweep's own balance (plan_probe.py), 4 A probe, same region geometry.
#   ceosopt_a<A>  THE SWEEP: the operator fights for the smallest probe (plan_probe.py --ceos): A1 A2 S3 A3 D4 retuned
#                 at this aperture, coma B2 against B4, C1/C3 rebalanced; A5 and A4 have no partner knob and set the
#                 floor. Ronchigram flatness ignored. 4 A where reachable, else the smallest d90.
# GEOMETRY (cols side win step detmax, read per row by run_thin_atomfind.sh): every leg is a 210 A x 210 A cut of the
# tiled, periodic labyrinth (simulate_4dstem --region-side), centred on the same material the 70 A box put under its
# scan (checked: all 1171 atoms within 15 A identical to 1e-14 A) -- bulk crystal all round instead of the 70 A box's
# x-vacuum. The recon window is side/BIN, sized from d99 (17.5 / 35 / 70 / 105 A); the detector is recorded to
# +-200 mrad unless the 105 A window needs a crop to +-133 mrad (N <= 1424 px, the engine's proven size); the scan
# field keeps scan/d90 >= 1.5 at 1600 positions. Seam margin >= 30 A beyond scan + d99 at 80 mrad.
# Analysis: GT = make_gt_cache --thin-cells 5 --z-vacuum 4 --region-side 210; atomfind --set scan_center_xy=105,105
# and each leg's dx from its h5 (0.0494 A at BIN 12 ... 0.074 A at 80 mrad).
# WINDOW: the 35 A minimum imposed on 2026-09-27 was WITHDRAWN on 09-28. Its evidence ("17.5 A kernels: 0 grid atoms")
# was extract_psf reading an engine checkpoint on Blythe; from the h5 every 17.5 A kernel is clean and round 70 at
# 17.5 A gives 98/83/81 %, z 0.56 A. The round_a040..a080 and ceosopt_a040/050 rows below say BIN 6 because that is
# what those labels last ran (the 09-27 rerun); their 17.5 A runs are the 2026-09-24 sweep. Both windows work.
# Optional col 15 nl_force: forces that row's recon layer count ('-' or absent = Nyquist over the full box).
